defectFoundByThisTesting.defect: Every refusal append read v_refusals || 'code', and an untyped literal on the right of || is parsed as an array literal, so the function raised "malformed array literal" the moment any refusal fired.
defectFoundByThisTesting.consequence: The two passing paths worked and every refusal path errored. Shipping it would have made the policy look permissive while actually being broken.
defectFoundByThisTesting.fix: Cast each literal to text. Fifteen sites.
defectFoundByThisTesting.foundBefore: any application beyond the disposable cluster
